# Vouch Rubric Fixtures

Source note: these are scrubbed, structure-preserving samples modeled from historical vouch phrasing patterns.

Redaction policy:

- no personal names
- no company names
- no phone/email identifiers
- metrics/timeframes retained where needed to preserve specificity shape

Fixture classes:

- `artifact_rich`: concrete systems, numbers, outcomes, ownership
- `adjective_heavy`: positive adjectives with little/no verifiable artifacts
